articles.summary: Authors: Kapil Kumar, Rahul Agarwal, Ratul Ray, Thanh Dang Searching for information is a crucial aspect of our daily routines. At Roku, we understand the importance of using search to quickly and efficiently discover and access content on our streaming platform. We developed a Search Ranking System that makes it easier for users to find the content … Continue reading "From Search to Watch: The Power of Roku’s Search Ranking System" The post From Search to Watch: The Power of Roku’s Search Ranking System appeared first on Engineering Blog .
